name: How much does bathroom waterproofing usually cost, and what changes the price?
description: Price depends on scope, materials, labor, and whether hidden damage is found. The cheapest bid can be risky if it leaves out critical waterproofing details.

mainEntity.name: How much does bathroom waterproofing usually cost, and what changes the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on whether you are waterproofing a shower only, a full bath, or a remodel that also includes demolition and repair of hidden damage. A lower bid is not necessarily a better value if it skips corners, drains, subfloor repair, or documentation.
